head: 16aca39fd1befa6d6514fca3525a0d29341ad98c
title: fix(coach): day-1 coach is promised only alerts that exist; no red 0% before the first client (HUNT-05-124, T1)
body:
HUNT-05-124 (agent 124) — coach day 1. Tier T1 (copy and display only; no money, auth, data or schema paths). 9 files, +151/-45.

## Findings fixed here

**B-H05-1 (false customer-facing claim).** A new coach opens the app, lands on Clients and reads "Turn on notifications so you see client messages and new client alerts"; Settings also shows Daily Check-in, New Client Alerts and Weekly Summary switched on. The backend stores those three preferences (`NotificationPreference.daily_checkin_enabled`, `new_client_alerts`, `weekly_summary_enabled`) but no code reads them and no emitter sends a new-client, weekly-summary or coach daily check-in push (backend main ec12a4b3: the only references are the defaults and the update in `src/notifications/notifications.service.ts:161-163, 252-254`). Normal-user story: a coach shares their code, the first client joins, and the coach waits for the promised alert that never comes.
- `src/components/home/PushPermissionCard.tsx`: coach copy now names only alerts the server sends to coaches today: "Turn on notifications so you see client messages and bookings as they arrive." (client messages: `messaging.service.ts` notifyNewMessage -> MessageReceivedEmitter.sendPush for either recipient; bookings: `booking.emitter.ts` role coach).
- `src/screens/coach/settings/SettingsToggles.tsx`: the three switches with no server feature are removed; Notification preferences and Haptics stay.

**U-H05-2 (empty state).** A coach with no clients yet opens Overview and sees a red "0%" check-in rate and "Active today 0 of 0". `OverviewScreen.tsx` now shows a neutral dash in stone and no "of 0" while the roster is empty; with clients the rate and colours are unchanged.

**U-H05-3 (wrong directions).** A coach who skips Stripe in the wizard reads "You can finish this later from the checklist on your Home screen", finishes, and finds no Home tab (tabs: Overview, Clients, Programs, Messages, Settings); the checklist is on Overview. `CoachWizardNavigator.tsx:354, 640` and `lib/coachSetup/errors.ts:198` now name the Overview tab.

## Tests (failing first)
- New `src/screens/coach/__tests__/coachDay1Hunt05.test.tsx` (4 tests). Commit 090cf05f adds it alone; lane run on that commit (no fix) is linked in the opening comment.
- Commit 6eef5a86 adds the U-H05-3 tests alone (source and describeError checks; main has "Home screen"/"Home checklist" in both files).
- Updated expected copy in `PushPermissionCard.test.tsx`, `ClientsListPushPrimer.test.tsx` and `coachSetupRound2.test.tsx`.

## Not in this PR (owner decision)
Real new-client alerts (backend emitter on every attach path + tap route) are a follow-up; see the opening comment.

No backend, schema, lockfile, Expo/EAS or money changes. No clinic partner name, no secrets.
